# Node contract: schemes, fields, codes

These pages are generated from the `contract/registry/` registry by `go generate ./contract/...`, and CI checks them against the registry on every PR. Hand edits are overwritten by the next run: change the registry instead.

## How to read these pages

```
share link          mapper                node body              sanitizer            core config
vless://…?…         ──▶ link parameter   ──▶  sing-box JSON,    ──▶  checks each     ──▶  what sing-box
                     becomes a body         stored in state        body field's         is actually
                     field                                         value                started with
```

Each scheme page lists the **link parameters** (the share-link dictionary and the body field every parameter becomes) and the **body fields** (the sing-box JSON kept in the launcher state, with the rule applied to each value). The body rules hold for every input alike — link, sing-box JSON, Xray JSON or a hand-filled form. Three more sections follow: the warning codes a node can carry, what is silently replaced on the way in, and what a bad value costs — a field or the whole node.

## Pipeline

Every input — a share URI, sing-box or Xray JSON, a wg-conf, a hand-written body — goes through the same three stages in both apps:

1. **mapper** — translates the dialect into a canonical body path using `uri.*.maps_to` and the registry aliases. It checks no values and fills in no defaults. Its structural translations are listed under **Replacements** on each scheme page.
2. **sanitizer** — runs the registry `body` sections: type, enum, format, `allowed_for`/`forbidden_for`, `conflicts`/`requires`. Every drop or coercion is recorded in `warnings[]` ([codes](warnings.md)).
3. **emitter** — serializes in `body.order`; there is no per-scheme branching in the code.

The normative text is [`contract/docs/CANON.md` §8](../CANON.md).

## Warning codes

[`warnings.md`](warnings.md) is the code dictionary: severity, what happened, why it happens, what you can do, and a reverse index of which field of which scheme raises each code.

## Limits

The canonical value; an app may currently enforce a lower one.

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| `amnezia_decompress_cap` | `4194304` |
| `amnezia_link_max_bytes` | `524288` |
| `amnezia_scan_depth` | `8` |
| `disabled_ttl_clamp` | `{"ceil_hours":720,"floor_hours":24,"intervals":3}` |
| `fetch_timeout_seconds` | `30` |
| `max_body_bytes` | `10485760` |
| `max_detour_chain` | `8` |
| `max_nodes_per_subscription` | `3000` |
| `max_uri_length` | `65536` |
